# Forgepoint

Forgepoint is a self-hosted code forge built around a small Rust core and extension-delivered product surfaces.

This demo instance is seeded from persisted runtime state, served through the Rust API, and rendered by the Astro frontend.

## Frontend

The frontend is a separate Astro/TypeScript/Bun app. It discovers backend capabilities through GraphQL introspection, core capability manifests, and extension UI manifests.
